mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.code, m.name, m.spec, u.name AS unit FROM base_material m LEFT JOIN base_unit u ON u.id = m.unit_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 AND m.id IN #{id}

SELECT m.id, m.code, m.name, m.spec, u.name AS unit FROM base_material m LEFT JOIN base_unit u ON u.id = m.unit_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1
AND (m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY m.id DESC

SELECT id FROM base_material WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1
AND (code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT id, name FROM base_warehouse WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY id LIMIT 100

SELECT id, name FROM base_supplier WHERE deleted = 0
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
SELECT material_id AS materialId, IFNULL(SUM(qty), 0) AS qty FROM inv_stock WHERE deleted = 0 AND material_id IN #{id} GROUP BY material_id

SELECT d.material_id AS materialId, IFNULL(SUM(d.qty - IFNULL(d.received_qty, 0)), 0) AS qty FROM pur_order o JOIN pur_order_detail d ON d.order_id = o.id WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND d.deleted = 0 AND o.status IN (10, 20) AND d.qty > IFNULL(d.received_qty, 0) AND d.material_id IN #{id} GROUP BY d.material_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_payable (supplier_id, biz_no, amount, status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{supplierId}, #{bizNo}, #{amount}, 'UNSETTLED', #{remark}, 0, NOW(), 0, NOW(), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME = #{tableName}
